approved.description: True only if the letter has no unsupported claims and no serious problem.

fabricatedClaims.description: Statements about the candidate that the CV does not support. Empty if none.

claim.description: The statement, quoted from the letter.

reason.description: Why the CV does not support it.

missingRequirements.description: Key requirements of the posting that the CV supports but the letter does not address. At most 10.

toneIssues.description: Problems of tone or language: generic, exaggerated, servile, wrong language. At most 5.

suggestions.description: Concrete changes for the writer, most important first. At most 5.
